description: Permanently delete only the JSON upload identified by upload_id; other uploads, filters, modules, and quota records are unaffected. Use after the final process_json query or when early removal is needed. Use get_upload to inspect availability first if uncertain; do not delete while the ID is still needed. Pass the exact secret ID returned by upload_json or REST POST /uploads, not a filename or URL. Anyone holding that ID can delete the upload; a UUID quota key is not an ownership credential. Returns success:true,deleted:true even if already deleted or expired, so retries are safe. Reusing a deleted ID for processing fails. Does not consume processing quota and remains available when that quota is exhausted. Invalid ID arguments are rejected; storage failure returns success:false,error,status:503.

upload_id.description: Exact secret upload_id returned by upload_json or POST /uploads; not a filename or URL. Anyone holding it can inspect, query, or delete that upload. Valid for 15 minutes.

name: delete_upload
title: Delete uploaded JSON
